records.region: Western Banks Island, Northwest Territories; Storkerson Bay receiving coast
records.candidate_name_role: No completed representative name while the selected opening-to-receiving-valley transfer is unestablished.
records.material_pending_reason: The necessary unresolved correspondence is the chosen eastern opening across the early east-to-west ponded/gullied upland strips into the southwest receiving valley, chiefly stored parts1-6. Available imagery supplies geographic coverage but not a continuous through-link.
records.geographic_disambiguation: Four successfully acquired and inspected imagery views cover all selected parts. The southwest receiving valley, westward meandering and braided corridor, lower delta and separate source/render terminal settings are geographically supported. CHS coastal prose supports Storkerson River and Storkerson Bay as bounded receiving identities. The early east-to-west selection crosses several intervening interfluves and separately south-trending ponded gullies; no continuous east-to-west receiving floor or transfer across those strips was established. One source-material-pending state is retained rather than applying a whole-system name.
records.completion_scope: Bounded pass covers all 25 parts and both terminal settings; the early cross-gully transfer in one-based parts1–6 remains unestablished, so full correspondence is incomplete.

scope_limits: The necessary unresolved correspondence is the chosen eastern opening across the early east-to-west ponded/gullied upland strips into the southwest receiving valley, chiefly stored parts1-6. Available imagery supplies geographic coverage but not a continuous through-link.
Storkerson River is a bounded receiving identity supported by coastal prose and delta geography; it is not promoted to the full selected feature while the opening transfer is pending.
No separate name is established for the initial feeder, individual small lakes, pond chains or side tributaries.
The imagery is a mosaic with differing water/ice appearance. Its exact source epochs, current flow and current shoreline are not established.
Separate source and rendered terminal settings are retained as landward/marginal delta settings rather than both being asserted as surveyed marine mouth points.

bounded_name_observations.name: Storkerson River
bounded_name_observations.scope: The large lower braided river and mouth at Storkerson Bay, supported by the coastal description and the inspected broad delta.
bounded_name_observations.limitation: Not a confirmed representative of the entire selected opening; no name is assigned to its small upper ponds or separate gullies.

bounded_name_observations.name: Storkerson Bay
bounded_name_observations.scope: Western Banks Island coastal receiving setting of the large braided river mouth.
bounded_name_observations.limitation: Bay name is not a river alias.

records.region: Coastal Texas: Bee–Goliad county boundary through Refugio County to Mission Bay
records.geographic_disambiguation: Representative name for the completely researched Blanco Creek–Mission River receiving system. The distinct upper Blanco Creek, joining creeks, adjacent lakes and Mission Bay keep their own identities; Mission River is not imposed as a uniform scalar name on every part.
records.completion_scope: Bounded research is complete for the sole stage3 mainstem fragment, every stored part and join, and the separate source/render endings. Representative receiving-system identity is supported without a new map-acquisition gap or a naming-scope hold.
records.supported_name_scope: Representative name for the completely researched Blanco Creek–Mission River receiving system. The distinct upper Blanco Creek, joining creeks, adjacent lakes and Mission Bay keep their own identities; Mission River is not imposed as a uniform scalar name on every part.

scope_limits: Generalized selected positions supplied orientation only. Exact bank alignment, current wetness, active channel choice, tidal exchange and present management operation are not established.
The lower wetland traverse is supported as a continuous mapped receiving corridor; no precise diagonal hydraulic route across Fennessey Flat is asserted.
The source endpoint occupies the mouth wetland/delta setting while the rendered endpoint lies farther into Mission Bay. Neither is moved to fit a mapped channel.
No formal registry verification, legal name boundary, Korean rendering or uniform whole-feature scalar name is supplied.

The Handbook entries are historical editorial prose accessed during this pass. They do not establish current channel conditions; search-result extracts and unrequested reports are not substantive evidence.

records.region: Northern Chile, Antofagasta Region: western dry opening, northward interior alluvial corridor and northern salt-pan-floor ending.
records.naming_scope_hold_reason: No inspected source securely names the complete selected composite or a representative receiving watercourse. ODEPA's coarse Profeta and Navidad labels are insufficient for this specific assignment, and imagery contains no hydronym labels.
records.geographic_disambiguation: The inspected sources establish the complete selected geographic setting but do not securely attach a natural-river name to this whole composite or identify a representative named receiving reach.
records.completion_scope: Three overlapping, completely acquired and actually inspected original imagery views cover all 24 stored parts and all joins through the actual source/render ending. Geographic correspondence is complete at ordinary dry-valley, alluvial-floor and salar-floor scale. The available naming evidence does not establish a representative river-system name, so the completed result retains a null name-scope hold.
records.supported_name_scope: The inspected sources establish the complete selected geographic setting but do not securely attach a natural-river name to this whole composite or identify a representative named receiving reach.

scope_limits: The whole selected composite's river name remains unsupported. This is a completed name-scope hold, not proof that local hydronyms do not exist.
Profeta and Navidad are actual regional-map labels but are not securely assigned to the chosen component or actual terminal from this small-scale source. A salar name would not be a river alias.

Imagery establishes ordinary geographic continuity; it does not certify exact banks, modern surface flow, seasonal overflow, drainage chemistry, natural hydrological termination or infrastructure operation.
Current online access and newly read imagery do not supply a verified imagery capture date or a formal naming-registry decision.

bounded_name_observations.name: Quebrada del Profeta
bounded_name_observations.scope: Directly read on the coarse ODEPA regional map south of Salar de Navidad. Its exact relation to the selected lower corridor is not sufficiently resolved by this small-scale map, so it is neither a representative candidate nor an alias of the selected system.

bounded_name_observations.name: Salar de Navidad
bounded_name_observations.scope: Direct regional salt-flat label on ODEPA's map. It is retained as broad northern regional context only, not assigned to the actual selected endpoint and never treated as a river alias.

terminal_correspondence.source_terminal_description: Northern pale marginal floor of the widened salt-pan/playa depression, reached through the same alluvial receiving corridor.
terminal_correspondence.render_terminal_description: Same northern salt-pan-floor location as the source endpoint; no displaced render-only extension.
terminal_correspondence.terminal_class_scope: Inventory classification retained only. A natural hydrological sink or a formal named river mouth is not independently certified.

reconstruction_rule: Start from the pinned r46 cumulative index and apply later append-only deltas in verified commit order, rejecting duplicate IDs. Keep base records, scope clauses, region qualifiers and assessment histories unchanged. Apply explicit status-list changes. Subtract all recorded IDs from the exact eligible initial inventory to recover unrecorded targets; pending IDs remain recorded but are not completed source reviews.
publication_boundary: Own factual name/scope findings, public official URLs, bounded geometry metadata and public continuity pins only. No original maps, crops, complete coordinates or private source/derivative/registration fingerprints. Official hosting does not establish source redistribution rights.

research_order.progress_rule: Follow the actual continental order: Americas, Asia, Africa, Europe, then other, with all rivers before lakes. Preserve original queue IDs and ranks for continuity; apply documented geographic deferrals without counting them as name research, and place deferred objects into their corrected later phase by length-descending, stable-ID order. Prior candidate and scope-held assessments remain unresolved where stated.
